Statement timeout 57014 was tested; lock timeout 55P03 was not. No runtime policy was changed.
Still awaiting your review of the documented central rejection/manual-replay policy before the expiry transaction branch, and authorized-side real-data preflight counts for the two 0126 existing-row checks. We have not accessed the real system. HR and salary can proceed independently of that later expiry decision, with early audit privacy and only new translation keys. Four wording branches stay last. Existing accepted labels and aliases stay intact. Reserved migrations 0124-0127 and ADRs 0243-0247 remain the only numbers we use; no additional allocation. No generator ran, original main/QA databases remain untouched, isolated test cluster is stopped.
